assumptions.statement: Submitted site boundary is the repository provisional rough polygon, not an official redline.
assumptions.impact: All geometry-derived areas and ratios are intake-grade and must be recalculated after official polygons are supplied.

assumptions.statement: All three key-area polygons are rough placeholders derived from public task materials.
assumptions.impact: Detailed-design moves are transferable concepts, not parcel, ownership or road-boundary conclusions.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, coverage, setbacks, road redlines and statutory controls are missing.
assumptions.impact: Development intensity remains unknown; no approved control values are asserted.

assumptions.statement: Complete existing building footprints, uses, heights, ages, condition and ownership are unavailable in authoritative current form.
assumptions.impact: Submitted building polygons are program envelopes only and do not decide demolition, retention or construction.

assumptions.statement: Road redlines, sections, verified crossing feasibility, traffic volumes, station interfaces, utilities and fire access are incomplete or unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Mobility and stitch lines express desired relationships or study axes only and require transport and engineering verification.

assumptions.statement: Detailed heritage protection GIS and intervention permissions for Jing-Zhang Railway Heritage Park and related sites are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Public-space, crossing and landmark concepts require heritage review before siting or material intervention.

assumptions.statement: Public-space ownership, operating permissions, universal-design audit, fire/egress conditions and maintenance responsibilities are incomplete.
assumptions.impact: Capability nodes and landmarks are reference components, not approved projects or fixed footprints.

assumptions.statement: Utilities, drainage, flood, energy, fire, structural and municipal capacity data are unavailable at sufficient design depth.
assumptions.impact: Edge-compute, robotics, active environmental systems and adaptive public-space services require later infrastructure and safety review.

assumptions.statement: Risk-tier authorization, Public Capability Interface, STOP/MODIFY/CONTINUE/SCALE and capability-transfer rules are design-governance proposals, not enacted regulation.
assumptions.impact: Implementation requires fact-specific legal, privacy, accessibility, cybersecurity, sector, public-participation and institutional review.

assumptions.statement: Urban Adaptation Rate and companion governance metrics are formula-ready proposals, but no adopted live eligible-issue, experiment or public-value outcome registry currently exists.
assumptions.impact: UAR-90, UAR-365, Responsible STOP Rate and related operational metric values remain unknown/null until real governed records exist.

assumptions.statement: Public Stewardship describes functional accountability; no named government institution, university, company, community body or operator is asserted to have accepted these roles.
assumptions.impact: All institutional names, budgets, staffing, procurement, authorization and service-level commitments remain future implementation decisions.

assumptions.statement: AI-enhanced public services must retain a safe, usable non-AI or human alternative appropriate to the service and affected population.
assumptions.impact: AI capability failure, refusal, lack of device/account access or withdrawal of consent must not remove the basic public service or ordinary public-space function.

assumptions.statement: Open-data basemap candidates and public project sources are cross-validation inputs with different authority; successful retrieval does not make a feature Verified or Official.
assumptions.impact: OSM, ML building footprints, public pages, imagery and field audit must retain provenance, date, license and uncertainty; conflicts remain visible rather than silently overwritten.
